title: 3dedgedog
description: Calculate edges in an image using the Difference of Gaussians (DOG) method with extensions/tweaks of the Marr-Hildreth algorithm.

mask.description: Mask dataset applied after Euclidean Distance Transform calculation
mask.title: Mask dataset

automask.description: Calculate mask automatically. Optionally, you can provide an integer X to dilate the initial automask X times (e.g., -automask+X)
automask.title: Automask

sigma_rad.description: Radius for 'inner' Gaussian, in mm; must be greater than 0 (default: 1.40)
sigma_rad.title: Sigma radius

sigma_nvox.description: Define radius for 'inner' Gaussian by providing a multiplicative factor for voxel edge length greater than 0 (default: use sigma_rad)
sigma_nvox.title: Sigma number of voxels

ratio_sigma.description: Ratio of inner and outer Gaussian sigma values (default: 1.40)
ratio_sigma.title: Ratio sigma

output_intermed.description: Output intermediate datasets: DOG, EDT2, BLURS (default: not output)
output_intermed.title: Output intermediates flag

edge_bnd_nn.description: Nearest neighbor (NN) value for connectedness of boundaries; must be 1 (face only), 2 (face+edge), or 3 (face+edge+node) (default: 1)
edge_bnd_nn.title: Edge boundary NN

edge_bnd_side.description: Specify boundary layer to use: NEG, POS, BOTH, BOTH_SIGN (default: NEG)
edge_bnd_side.title: Edge boundary side

edge_bnd_scale.description: Scale edge values to have relative magnitude between 0 and 100 (default: edge locations have value=1)
edge_bnd_scale.title: Edge boundary scale flag

only2d.description: Calculate edges in 2D per plane specified by SLI: 'axi', 'cor', 'sag'
only2d.title: Only 2D slice
